findings.description: Catch block is empty — Stripe errors (rate limits, card declines, network failures, misconfiguration) are silently swallowed and the endpoint returns { ok: true } even when no charge occurred. This is a payments correctness bug: callers cannot distinguish a successful charge from a failed one. At minimum log the error; ideally propagate it or return a distinct failure state so callers can react. Silencing errors is not the same as handling them.
